library(readxl)
library(xml2)

if (!exists("get_workbook_path", mode = "function") ||
    !exists("get_project_root", mode = "function")) {
  candidates <- c("_data_helpers.R", "Course File Resources/_data_helpers.R",
                  "../_data_helpers.R", "_data_helpers_schema_only.R",
                  "Course File Resources/_data_helpers_schema_only.R",
                  "../_data_helpers_schema_only.R")
  found <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(found)) stop("Cannot locate course-file data helpers.")
  source(found[1])
}

# Excel Ctrl+K hyperlinks live in OOXML relationships, not cell values.
# Return cell references, target paths, and displayed cell values.
read_excel_folder_links <- function(workbook, sheet_name) {
  archive <- unzip(workbook, list = TRUE)$Name
  temp <- tempfile("excel_links_")
  dir.create(temp)
  on.exit(unlink(temp, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  get_xml <- function(name) {
    if (!name %in% archive) return(NULL)
    unzip(workbook, files = name, exdir = temp)
    read_xml(file.path(temp, name))
  }
  attr_local <- function(node, key) {
    attrs <- xml_attrs(node)
    hit <- which(sub("^.*[}:]", "", names(attrs)) == key)
    if (length(hit)) unname(attrs[hit[1]]) else NA_character_
  }
  nodes <- function(doc, tag) {
    if (is.null(doc)) return(xml_find_all(read_xml("<empty/>"), "./missing"))
    xml_find_all(doc, paste0(".//*[local-name()='", tag, "']"))
  }
  book <- get_xml("xl/workbook.xml")
  book_rels <- get_xml("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels")
  if (is.null(book) || is.null(book_rels)) stop("Workbook XML is unavailable.")
  sheets <- nodes(book, "sheet")
  match_sheet <- sheets[vapply(sheets, function(s) identical(xml_attr(s, "name"), sheet_name), logical(1))]
  if (!length(match_sheet)) stop("Worksheet not found: ", sheet_name)
  sheet_id <- attr_local(match_sheet[[1]], "id")
  rels <- nodes(book_rels, "Relationship")
  sheet_rel <- rels[vapply(rels, function(x) identical(xml_attr(x, "Id"), sheet_id), logical(1))]
  if (!length(sheet_rel)) stop("Worksheet relationship missing: ", sheet_name)
  target <- xml_attr(sheet_rel[[1]], "Target")
  sheet_xml <- if (startsWith(target, "/")) sub("^/", "", target) else
    paste0("xl/", sub("^\\./", "", target))
  sheet_xml <- gsub("/[^/]+/\\.\\./", "/", sheet_xml)
  sheet_doc <- get_xml(sheet_xml)
  if (is.null(sheet_doc)) stop("Worksheet XML unavailable: ", sheet_xml)

  # Schema range A7:I51: row 7 is the secondary header,
  # records begin in Excel row 8; activity descriptions are in F.
  configured_range <- if (exists("cf_range", mode = "function"))
    cf_range("lesson_plan") else "A7:I51"
  if (!is.character(configured_range) || length(configured_range) != 1L)
    stop("lesson_plan range must be a single A1 range string")
  start_row <- as.integer(sub("^[A-Z]+([0-9]+):.*$", "\\1", configured_range))
  end_row <- as.integer(sub("^.*:[A-Z]+([0-9]+)$", "\\1", configured_range))
  if (is.na(start_row) || is.na(end_row)) stop("Invalid range: ", configured_range)
  table <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(
    workbook, sheet = sheet_name, range = configured_range,
    col_names = FALSE, .name_repair = "minimal"), check.names = FALSE)
  col_idx <- 6L
  col_letter <- "F"
  first_data_row <- max(8L, start_row + 1L)
  rel_path <- paste0(dirname(sheet_xml), "/_rels/", basename(sheet_xml), ".rels")
  link_rels <- get_xml(rel_path)
  relationship_nodes <- nodes(link_rels, "Relationship")
  hyperlinks <- nodes(sheet_doc, "hyperlink")
  output <- list()
  for (h in hyperlinks) {
    cell <- xml_attr(h, "ref")
    if (!grepl(paste0("^", col_letter, "[0-9]+$"), cell)) next
    rid <- attr_local(h, "id")
    rel <- relationship_nodes[vapply(relationship_nodes,
      function(x) identical(xml_attr(x, "Id"), rid), logical(1))]
    path <- if (length(rel)) xml_attr(rel[[1]], "Target") else xml_attr(h, "location")
    if (is.na(path) || !nzchar(path)) next
    row_number <- as.integer(sub("^[A-Z]+", "", cell))
    if (row_number < first_data_row || row_number > end_row) next
    table_idx <- row_number - start_row + 1L
    if (table_idx < 1L || table_idx > nrow(table)) next
    activity <- as.character(table[[col_idx]][table_idx])
    if (is.na(activity) || !nzchar(trimws(activity))) next
    output[[length(output) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      cell = cell, activity = trimws(activity), target = path,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  if (!length(output)) return(data.frame(cell = character(), activity = character(), target = character()))
  do.call(rbind, output)
}

# Decode Excel hyperlink targets and locate evidence folders. Prefer paths
# relative to the workbook, but also support links relative to project root.
resolve_evidence_folder <- function(target, workbook, root) {
  path <- utils::URLdecode(target)
  path <- sub("^file:///", "", path, ignore.case = TRUE)
  path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", path)
  path <- sub("^\\./", "", path)
  path <- sub("/$", "", path)
  if (grepl("^[A-Za-z]+://", path)) return(NULL)
  if (grepl("^/[A-Za-z]:/", path)) path <- substring(path, 2)
  absolute <- grepl("^([A-Za-z]:/|/|//)", path)
  candidates <- if (absolute) path else c(
    file.path(dirname(workbook), path),
    file.path(root, path),
    file.path(root, "Course File Resources", path)
  )
  # Excel may store project-relative paths that begin at the resources folder.
  for (candidate in unique(candidates)) {
    if (dir.exists(candidate)) return(normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/"))
  }
  NULL
}

# Emit a portable image reference relative to the chapter's QMD directory.
# Quarto resolves Markdown image links relative to the source document.
chapter_image_path <- function(image, root) {
  chapter_dir <- file.path(root, "Course File Resources")
  img <- normalizePath(image, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  base <- normalizePath(chapter_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  prefix <- paste0(sub("/+$", "", base), "/")
  if (!startsWith(tolower(img), tolower(prefix))) return(NULL)
  substring(img, nchar(prefix) + 1L)
}

clean_heading <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[_-]+", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("[\\r\\n#*`<>|\\[\\]]", " ", x)
  trimws(gsub(" +", " ", x))
}

activity_heading <- function(x) {
  # Keep the activity name exactly as written, except line breaks.
  trimws(gsub("[\r\n]+", " ", as.character(x)))
}

natural_sort <- function(x) {
  # Sort 1.png, 2.png, 10.png in numeric order.
  nm <- basename(x)
  numbers <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^([0-9]+).*", "\\1", nm)))
  x[order(is.na(numbers), numbers, tolower(nm))]
}

workbook <- get_workbook_path()
if (is.na(workbook) || !file.exists(workbook)) {
  stop("Course workbook not found.")
}
root <- get_project_root()
worksheet <- if (exists("cf_sheet", mode = "function")) cf_sheet("lesson_plan") else "9.Lesson_Plan"
links <- read_excel_folder_links(workbook, worksheet)
seen_folders <- character()
shown <- 0L

for (i in seq_len(nrow(links))) {
  folder <- resolve_evidence_folder(links$target[i], workbook, root)
  if (is.null(folder)) {
    warning("Folder hyperlink not found in ", links$cell[i], ": ", links$target[i])
    next
  }
  if (tolower(folder) %in% seen_folders) next
  seen_folders <- c(seen_folders, tolower(folder))

  images <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE,
                       recursive = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  images <- images[file.exists(images)]
  if (!length(images)) next
  shown <- shown + 1L
  cat("\n\n### ", activity_heading(links$activity[i]), " {.unnumbered}\n\n", sep = "")

  # Organize evidence by relative subfolder (Notes, Assignments/HA_1, etc.).
  relative <- substring(gsub("\\\\", "/", images), nchar(folder) + 2L)
  subfolders <- dirname(relative)
  for (subfolder in unique(subfolders)) {
    if (subfolder != ".") {
      pieces <- strsplit(subfolder, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      cat("\n\n#### ", paste(vapply(pieces, clean_heading, character(1)), collapse = " / "),
          " {.unnumbered}\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    for (image in natural_sort(images[subfolders == subfolder])) {
      link <- chapter_image_path(image, root)
      if (is.null(link)) {
        warning("Image outside Course File Resources: ", image)
        next
      }
      # Escape spaces and punctuation for Markdown destinations.
      cat("![](<", link, ">){width=95%}\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
}
if (!shown) cat("*No linked evidence folders containing PNG images were found.*\n\n")
